report:
Reviewed the complete operator_calls claim, all five ordinary implementation associations (expr, operator, infer_ctx, infer::obligations, finalize), the semantic_spec TODO implementation association, and the sole associated TODO test. Added missing associations at operator construction, expression recovery, recovery-aware deduplication, and final call copying, then restarted and reviewed current inputs. The captured architectural decision reserves primitive specialization for future codegen.

Requirements and implementation: ExprCstKind::Binary checks both operands independently and delegates to check_binary_operator. Its mapping distinguishes all sixteen overloadable arithmetic, bitwise, shift and comparison tokens, excluding And/Or. The lazy operators constrain operands to bool and retain Binary control flow; they are outside this claim's non-short-circuit guarantee. The overloadable path loads the core method signature and substitutes separate left/right types. It performs no token-based numeric-domain narrowing and no blanket left-equals-right unification. Signature checks use disposable equality probes; committed argument equalities arise from the instantiated method signature. Associated Output is retained as a normalization obligation, while comparisons use the actual bool return. The call records function, StaticTrait self and trait reference, independent owner arguments, adjusted receiver and argument, and result type. This path contains no primitive-specific lowering, and finalization preserves ResolvedCall and its dispatch/type arguments while resolving transient slots. Thus the same representation is available for supported primitive and user-defined proofs; full generic-body and unknown-Self inference support remains explicitly deferred by the TODO entry, not certified complete here.

Ambiguity/unsupported handling: missing or unsupported metadata/signatures and operand errors return diagnosed Error nodes. Each provisional call has an obligation recovery slot. infer_ctx retains proof/normalization goals, keeps Maybe stalled until the terminal pass, and fails terminal ambiguity or conditional residuals; No fails immediately. fail_obligation and recover_expr_slots replace the provisional expression with Error, and finish rejects pending obligations. I checked a possible recovery-loss issue in duplicate proofs: same_dedup_key requires equal recovery vectors (including slot/span/watched types) and only merges proof goals, so distinct operator expression slots cannot silently lose recovery through this dedup path. This source inspection resolves the initial suspicion; no reproduced behavioral failure is claimed.

Test adequacy and deferral: the complete associated test set contains only sage_meta::todo::checking_body_operator_calls, an empty test body whose comments specify the outstanding matrix. It asserts no behavior and is accepted solely as an explicit deferred test, never as passing verification. Its prerequisite is finishing generic operator bodies and unknown-Self candidate hints and then wiring source/oracle and query-trace tests. The deferred matrix explicitly includes every mapping, heterogeneous integer shifts, ordinary external core impl proof identities, positive/negative expressions, primitive/generic/nonnumeric/user-defined operations, differing Rhs/Output, Any-domain preservation, lazy booleans and rejection of 1 + true. This accounts for all current test gaps without claiming complete implementation or evidence. There are no N/A entries. The ordinary operator file additionally contains an unassociated mapping unit test with actual equality assertions for sixteen mappings and None for And/Or; it supplies useful local evidence but does not replace the associated deferred matrix.

Commands actually executed: cargo fmt; cargo build (passed with existing warnings); cargo test -p sage-ir every_overloadable_binary_token_maps_to_its_method --lib (one test passed). Review start/read captured current source and RFD context. No end-to-end operator, oracle, or full-workspace test execution is claimed. The explicit implementation/test TODO remains visible; no further edits are required for this partial/deferred assessment.
